manifest.title: T348 — Known-referee Irrationality path calibration
manifest.description: Frozen synthetic calibration of address openness, stochastic residual and retained closure history.

query.description: Generate 2,016 declared periodic, irrational, deterministic-chaotic, finite-stochastic and continuous-stochastic paths; calculate frozen raw-history coordinates and closure records without using family labels in the calculations.
filters: Holdout rows only for reported coordinate medians
Fixed ridge thresholds x_P=1 and x_R=1
metric_definitions: x_P: twice the clipped log-log support-growth slope across 16, 32, 64, 128 and 256 bins
x_R: twice the causal local-prediction loss divided by a matched no-history loss, capped at 2
closure coherence: median magnitude of the complex lag relation across lags 1 through 512
sector accuracy: share of holdout paths on the expected side of fixed ridges x_P=1 and x_R=1

blocks.body:
# T348 — Known-referee Irrationality path calibration

**Frozen benchmark:** SUPPORTED — synthetic known-referee instrument only.

## Technical summary

All five preregistered gates passed. Fixed ARA ridge cuts recovered the expected broad sector for **95.65%** of 1,104 untouched holdout paths; macro family accuracy was **90.00%**. This calibrates the measuring instrument under synthetic known conditions. It is not yet evidence for a universal physical law.

## Findings

Irrational rotation and continuous stochastic motion both opened addresses, but the former remained relation-determined while the latter retained a maximal stochastic residual. Chronology destruction moved the three deterministic families on the history axis without changing their address-support coordinate. Retained closure history distinguished exact rational closure from coherent irrational non-closure and incoherent wandering.

## Limitation

One of two deterministic-chaos parameter groups fell just below the fixed openness ridge, leaving deterministic chaos at **50%** sector accuracy. The current x_P coordinate measures support-growth dimension, not every possible meaning of non-closure. The uncompressed closure-history child remains necessary.

## Next rung

Transfer the frozen instrument unchanged to a controlled public physical system with independently documented periodic, quasiperiodic, chaotic and noise-dominated regimes. Freeze the physical observable and circular/path mapping before opening the regime labels.

charts.title: Holdout family median ARA coordinates
charts.subtitle: The two coordinates separate address openness from stochastic residual; closure coherence remains available as child/history context.

query.description: Return the five reviewed holdout family medians used by the report chart.
query.sql: WITH family_summary(family,n_paths,median_x_p,median_x_r,median_closure,sector_accuracy,expected_sector) AS (VALUES ('periodic rational',336,0.0,0.0,1.0,1.0,'finite / determinate'),('irrational rotation',240,2.0,0.0000013961,1.0,1.0,'open / determinate'),('deterministic chaos',96,1.4965694135,0.0000667448,0.0499238386,0.5,'open / determinate'),('finite stochastic',336,0.0,2.0,0.0133898211,1.0,'finite / stochastic'),('continuous stochastic',96,1.9779974983,2.0,0.1097601024,1.0,'open / stochastic')) SELECT * FROM family_summary ORDER BY CASE family WHEN 'periodic rational' THEN 1 WHEN 'irrational rotation' THEN 2 WHEN 'deterministic chaos' THEN 3 WHEN 'finite stochastic' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END;

query.description: Return the five independently reviewed frozen gate outcomes.
query.sql: WITH gate_results(gate_order,gate,result,key_value) AS (VALUES (1,'Potential orientation','PASS','All five family medians passed'),(2,'Residual orientation','PASS','All five family medians passed'),(3,'Broad-sector recovery','PASS','95.65% versus 85% floor'),(4,'Closure independence','PASS','Irrational miss improved in 100%'),(5,'Order-destruction control','PASS','delta x_R +1.973 to +2.000; delta x_P 0')) SELECT * FROM gate_results ORDER BY gate_order ASC;
